text: Objective 7 progress bar text clipped: shows 'bers 5/10 · Buildings 0/2' (Members cut off) in the objective box at top-left
Trade at Market (apples): line says 'Best price in reach: 21 at the Village of Bigwood. Sell there, not here: -1 a unit' while this market pays 22 — advises selling at a worse price
Receipt/profit lines live in a 2-line scroll box under the buttons; the 'This visit: spent 0, took 104, net +104' line is only visible after scrolling (tick ~13900). Works, but easy to miss

Charlotte Evans is listed as Trader (O > Members) but no event/chronicle said she became one, nothing on screen shows what she carries or where she is going, and over ticks 19083-20431 she stays within 5 m of home. There is no Appoint Trader button for other serfs and no text saying why (one trader per settlement is the cap)

Send Caravan panel jumps: once the first good is loaded an estimate line appears and the auto-sized panel re-centres ~34 px higher, so the next clicks land on different buttons (my +5 Saplings presses hit Wood/nothing, '<' missed). Also '5 goods (wood), worth about 13 coins there' while the row says wood sells 24 there — estimate looks ~10x low or unexplained

HUD overlap inside settlement: Inventory Info panel sits on top of the Chronicle box (its title line covers 'Day 2, dawn...'), and a pawn nameplate ('Samantha Lewis / Greedy, Ambitious') draws over the chronicle text

Command bar reflows when a pawn walks into/out of range (pawn rows Order/Talk/Gift/Invite appear/disappear), so buttons shift under the pointer: clicking where 'Trade at Market' was ate an apple instead ('Ate an apple (+15 energy)'), tick ~30450. Same root as the caravan panel jumping
Travelling merchant event says an axe and pickaxe are 'worth hundreds at any market', but the Trade at Market panel only lists Apples/Wood/Stone/Saplings — tools cannot be sold anywhere I found

Markets run dry fast: after selling 6 apples and 3 wood the tills hold 10 coins and the panel says 'No till here can pay for one' / 'Can't sell' (tick 31389). With 62 wood and 58 stone on hand, the home market can absorb only a handful per visit — selling pays per unit (16-24 coins) but volume is capped by merchant cash

Caravan: loaded 5 wood, 10 stone, 15 saplings (estimate 'worth about 228'). It sold 5 wood + 9 stone at Eastton for 228 and 'came home ... with 228 coins'. The 15 saplings and 1 stone are never mentioned again: not in my inventory, and Collect Stockpile returned only wood/stone. Panel estimate silently priced saplings at 0 though the row said 'here 8, there 18'
